research_record.next_earnings: common_fact (exact date, or {earliest, latest} range, or UNKNOWN)
research_record.verification_status: PENDING | VERIFIED | INVALID | UNKNOWN (auto-reverts to PENDING whenever record_updated_at > verified_at)
research_record.valid_until: ISO-8601 with offset; set to the next scheduled pre-US-session refresh, never more than 24h after retrieved_at, and cut to now on material news

wheel_card.paper_universe_eligible: common_fact (true | false | UNKNOWN), matched against the guide's Wheel universe list

usable_rule: Runner may use a record for new exposure only when verification_status == VERIFIED, verified_at >= record_updated_at, and now < valid_until. An evidence_kind RUMOUR fact can never satisfy an eligibility fact; it may only add a risk flag.

scout_alert.note: An alert is never a trade signal on its own; News may cut a record's valid_until to now from it.
